title: Reach Block
description: A simple mod that allows players to modify their reach distance (up to 64 blocks). only supports Forge 1.20.1.
body:
A simple mod that allows players to modify their reach distance (up to 64 blocks).
This is not a cheat mod — only players with OP permissions can make changes.
only supports Forge 1.20.1 now.
| Command | Effect | Permission Required |
|---------|--------|---------------------|
| `/reachblock` | Displays your own distance | None (any player) |
| `/reachblock Steve` | Displays Steve's distance | OP level 2 |
| `/reachblock 8.5` | Sets your own distance to 8.5 | OP level 2 |
| `/reachblock Steve 12.0` | Sets Steve's distance to 12 | OP level 2 |
| `/reachblock reset` | Resets your own distance to 4.5 | OP level 2 |
| `/reachblock Steve reset` | Resets Steve's distance to 4.5 | OP level 2 |
